# AI in Finance — Daily Brief — 2026-08-03

**Executive summary** — The AI trade produced its first celebrity casualty: Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness fund — the "Nostradamus of AI" — reportedly dropped 67% in July on leveraged AI bets [42](https://news.google.?oc=5), and Ken Griffin's Citadel swooped in to buy most of the portfolio after the forced unwind [22](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxPb09TRG9hMWpZSzlBejI1SzZDS29Yd1hxUFRsN204QktRM2ZDNmMtSTBkcEFuM2JTX0NZbDRLT3pnalc3WkJibTNKSWtsZ1dvdGwzSDM1cUIxd3ZOSlJodWF5RXlvdmhNanFabmlYY3RLd1VrLXRKelNKSEVDemVIY1lPNmc2VGhKZllZNVU1S1pKTU43RWl3SFh3Yk9nT0hhd01JQnhqaVlkd1hOTjVzNC1yUQ?oc=5) [17](https://news.google.?oc=5). While one fund face-planted, the index crowd quietly won the decade: Vanguard's VOO crossed $1 trillion [33](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxNUUM0VU5ncWwzR2pwSE5FYmFDUDBBUGhOclE0dG1BOUVpVVBrMjRCUnFtWllIWGo4UkQxdE5KdjhsaU5jaUl5Yy0ydGhjR3pjYXppNU5KcVgwNlpOV01lam5OSjZJamlIQmhmX001SkFzTmFjT3NwRGNzc0ZaQ0FPc0hrNzJVa254LTQ5ZzFScFdDZ3dIV1V5Qmg0X2lkZVU0RG1yVGlSb0xKMHg4Y0xmOWJWR2Vwdl8t?oc=5) and AI-related ETFs now account for a record 19% of all US ETF trading volume [45](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE9YbXd4OGxsZENYcTJWcFBOcEpoQk4td0RBdWduZUdJclZvcndCQlotTjBySldLX0dWNmktY1lJUW9FOFBaczR6ZUpTMDBxSmJIRjFRVGk5czFfM1JocnQxX1ZCcVJja3Bf?oc=5). Meanwhile the EU AI Act's wider enforcement kicked in — chatbots must now confess they're AI [13](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNaExWYzk5TFdiR25TUjlGbVNpX2R4bUt3V0ZHamowSGJrOC1UR1NwR0FYQ2hRcUI5M0RmNjEyMUJDeWV5eUs2eUJyQzBvM0w5RE80Qjc1V2NpT1gyY1o5MlltX2JWcUllS2NtNWp0SFR6SkVJZjMzNXk2alIwT0RQWQ?oc=5) [67](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE16WGZDaFdEd2x5aTFOendoUm5nT2RCTWZuMmt1eE5fNU5HNFBHNXU3a0puUllwZzJvbXFXY3JSdTBJNTdwU1dMa25abFpnZ0p2QnlyRno2eWJJaG8wYnN3NlhoQ3NtV2preU1YTW9BWG5aUG14M1FWajNR?oc=5) — and Bloomberg says retail traders armed with AI are turning themselves into DIY hedge funds [44](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxQd1Vqc1FXWFJ0S3FtaWxVcDQwVUFZYlNQUDZGNjhNaGJTQWtNN2YtTk82OWtqckxsb1dCZGVwR1BpRTFXelNoc0p6SkNmTGVlV0FHTGJMTy0tQThMeEhFVU1fV1JNcFZwRFFfU0lUeFB6aF9LbWRuY294SEcyUjJGc0g3UTlSRUgwZ1IyLU5yUGU1X3Z1Vl9rQmpGdmpPMjZ4SjdqZE9mLUlwOWxOUWMyZzg5TmczV3c?oc=5). Lesson of the week, per one commentator: he was right about AI and wrong about leverage [85](https://news.google.?oc=5). Those are different skills.

## Top developments

**1. A $45B AI fund blew up, and Wall Street's cleanup crew arrived in a Citadel jacket.** Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness hedge fund reportedly fell 67% in July on leveraged AI bets [42](https://news.google.?oc=5), a collapse RealClearMarkets summarized as "how to build a $45 billion hedge fund and blow it up in days" [39](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxNNE1tLVdOa21yaWFyNXI0d0JXaE5LVFoycDJKSDV6eTNSUWs3UEtlZm5HUkNDbXZVc1RxRVpPQmt2bjE3VlhkOUtwLTdiVUZ4QnJER2ZmalNlV0U5U2ZRUGg5RWcxZU1xdGUxTzVRZXNkQzVUVl9RNXRuZjdJVUt6NHVHNXhMN0JzeW1VeDZ2UENna2xsSExiUnY1WWd5cG5ZX0JtUXdTbFRPUVFzRVVEVmR5dkJTT28?oc=5). Reuters-sourced reporting says Citadel bought most of the fund's stock holdings after the rout [22](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxPb09TRG9hMWpZSzlBejI1SzZDS29Yd1hxUFRsN204QktRM2ZDNmMtSTBkcEFuM2JTX0NZbDRLT3pnalc3WkJibTNKSWtsZ1dvdGwzSDM1cUIxd3ZOSlJodWF5RXlvdmhNanFabmlYY3RLd1VrLXRKelNKSEVDemVIY1lPNmc2VGhKZllZNVU1S1pKTU43RWl3SFh3Yk9nT0hhd01JQnhqaVlkd1hOTjVzNC1yUQ?oc=5); the Economic Times casts it as Griffin riding to the rescue again [17](https://news.google.?oc=5) [8](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE15Z1VPcHVQV3d5ZmpjY19MdEZnNV82LW9QdklUUXdmUjVKdjljQ3dKT0ZpYWh2S0pvZHJDYXQ5aE1yU2ZUcHZSVmZlU2FtcGZBV0RrVkJiTUVwLUV0V3FRa3p4a21JT3JmZ0VmRC00QjBYdE5PRFE?oc=5). *Why it matters:* this is the AI trade's first genuine forced-unwind story, and it validates July's warning signs from the quant pain. The thesis didn't fail — the leverage did. Expect prime brokers to start asking harder questions about gross exposure on AI books.

**2. The EU AI Act's enforcement era actually started.** Wider enforcement began August 2 [13](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNaExWYzk5TFdiR25TUjlGbVNpX2R4bUt3V0ZHamowSGJrOC1UR1NwR0FYQ2hRcUI5M0RmNjEyMUJDeWV5eUs2eUJyQzBvM0w5RE80Qjc1V2NpT1gyY1o5MlltX2JWcUllS2NtNWp0SFR6SkVJZjMzNXk2alIwT0RQWQ?oc=5): chatbots must now disclose they're AI and deepfakes need labels [67](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE16WGZDaFdEd2x5aTFOendoUm5nT2RCTWZuMmt1eE5fNU5HNFBHNXU3a0puUllwZzJvbXFXY3JSdTBJNTdwU1dMa25abFpnZ0p2QnlyRno2eWJJaG8wYnN3NlhoQ3NtV2preU1YTW9BWG5aUG14M1FWajNR?oc=5), with transparency rules live as of today [107](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE5DZUIyd3VxVGZkdHFQQVZDNjRuT2J5VThNLWkxTU9HZVVVS3duNjRuQnlFT09CY1Bob21EVVBMcTlHMXRORW5RY0EtdGZCSHljZ3dMYURIT2txMmRubUlGR09ZOElGY0NDaDVqajRB?oc=5). *Why it matters:* every AI-powered client interface in finance — robo-advisers, service bots, "AI insights" — now has a compliance surface in the EU. The era of quietly bolting a chatbot onto a wealth app is over.

**3. **4. The boring giants are having a great war.** Morgan Stanley's IPO after-party has become a wealth-management bonanza per the FT [20](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQOV9Ia3ZGN09FaE81ODJWUVBNNVB3eGxfbVdVUHhBdGtjQmR4ODVhZ1JJSVlIalhFMmM4cnZZbTBMbnNoaHJJUWlUa0k4ZE15ZTBkeGh0a3NqTkw4S1N3YXRDRVNwUnB4aG42b3RQTGU0OFY0Si1xc2Rsci1tUFZfMXpmVzA?oc=5), with one report putting client assets past $10 trillion [86](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxNNE1pYnEycmRFVFV2SWZlOE5CQlVLUmxKSi1NVlRtVVpEXzljM3MzVUR1SldMQ2RGbWxxNWZaRXVqZm0wN0lHbC1kWm50b0xRamVTbDgteERRUWk1aU9raDUybkJoak5Wck1KZlNFNC02d2xKNDBUTklnd0VrMU82dmsybw?oc=5) (low confidence — headline only). NatWest posted profits up a fifth after an AI-led tech drive and wealth focus [57](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxNUlZpQ1ktdjhNQ2YzdDJLT0wxTzJya0FNME1TRlg1NVhENkktWGNwZDFZaWxVQWhMWXZYV2twM1h5Z2pQRm5OS2ZuYjVWdGpvdHI1SWVNajY5czhHUXZuQ0REWE1BeEs1T3ZGZFRDek5fQUlnOE54MGZGbVJEQWxyTlN4LUtWa3JVSUhUZ2RWcXEyd0F1UDVXTWhMN09uS05lNm9JWlFRQzgxWm1sX2c?oc=5), and UBS's chief pinned market jitters on geopolitics, not AI valuations, as Q2 profit surged [72](https://news.google.?oc=5). *Why it matters:* while headlines chase blowups, the incumbents are converting AI into margins and gathering assets. The banks' AI story is compounding, not combusting.

**5. The picks-and-shovels trade now includes people.** Meta, Google and BlackRock are putting $265M into training data-center construction workers [14](https://news.google.?oc=5), fueling a hiring race for skilled trades [15](https://news.google.?oc=5). *Why it matters:* when the bottleneck moves from chips to electricians, the capex cycle is real. Infrastructure demand is also broadening beyond hyperscalers to enterprise and sovereign buyers, per Goldman [81](https://news.google.?oc=5).

## Since the last brief (2026-07-10)

Three weeks of runway, one clean arc: July 10's story was quant funds bleeding from the crowded AI trade; today that pressure claimed an actual fund, via the oldest mechanism in the book — leverage meets drawdown [42](https://news.google.?oc=5). July's "agentic finance is outrunning the rulebook" signal also matured on schedule: then it was JPMorgan testing money-moving agents; now it's retail traders running DIY AI hedge funds [44](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxQd1Vqc1FXWFJ0S3FtaWxVcDQwVUFZYlNQUDZGNjhNaGJTQWtNN2YtTk82OWtqckxsb1dCZGVwR1BpRTFXelNoc0p6SkNmTGVlV0FHTGJMTy0tQThMeEhFVU1fV1JNcFZwRFFfU0lUeFB6aF9LbWRuY294SEcyUjJGc0g3UTlSRUgwZ1IyLU5yUGU1X3Z1Vl9rQmpGdmpPMjZ4SjdqZE9mLUlwOWxOUWMyZzg5TmczV3c?oc=5) while the EU's disclosure regime goes live [67](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE16WGZDaFdEd2x5aTFOendoUm5nT2RCTWZuMmt1eE5fNU5HNFBHNXU3a0puUllwZzJvbXFXY3JSdTBJNTdwU1dMa25abFpnZ0p2QnlyRno2eWJJaG8wYnN3NlhoQ3NtV2preU1YTW9BWG5aUG14M1FWajNR?oc=5). And the institutional two-step continues: BlackRock was trimming exposure in July; today it's co-funding data-center workforces [14](https://news.google.?oc=5) and letting the index machines gather trillions [33](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxNUUM0VU5ncWwzR2pwSE5FYmFDUDBBUGhOclE0dG1BOUVpVVBrMjRCUnFtWllIWGo4UkQxdE5KdjhsaU5jaUl5Yy0ydGhjR3pjYXppNU5KcVgwNlpOV01lam5OSjZJamlIQmhmX001SkFzTmFjT3NwRGNzc0ZaQ0FPc0hrNzJVa254LTQ5ZzFScFdDZ3dIV1V5Qmg0X2lkZVU0RG1yVGlSb0xKMHg4Y0xmOWJWR2Vwdl8t?oc=5).

## Emerging signals & risks

- **Leverage is the AI trade's real fault line.** The first blowup wasn't a thesis failure — the AI names still power indexes — it was gross exposure [39](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxNNE1tLVdOa21yaWFyNXI0d0JXaE5LVFoycDJKSDV6eTNSUWs3UEtlZm5HUkNDbXZVc1RxRVpPQmt2bjE3VlhkOUtwLTdiVUZ4QnJER2ZmalNlV0U5U2ZRUGg5RWcxZU1xdGUxTzVRZXNkQzVUVl9RNXRuZjdJVUt6NHVHNXhMN0JzeW1VeDZ2UENna2xsSExiUnY1WWd5cG5ZX0JtUXdTbFRPUVFzRVVEVmR5dkJTT28?oc=5) [85](https://news.google.?oc=5). Watch for prime brokers tightening terms on concentrated AI books.
- **Rescue capital is concentrating power.** Citadel absorbing a distressed AI portfolio at forced-seller prices [22](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxPb09TRG9hMWpZSzlBejI1SzZDS29Yd1hxUFRsN204QktRM2ZDNmMtSTBkcEFuM2JTX0NZbDRLT3pnalc3WkJibTNKSWtsZ1dvdGwzSDM1cUIxd3ZOSlJodWF5RXlvdmhNanFabmlYY3RLd1VrLXRKelNKSEVDemVIY1lPNmc2VGhKZllZNVU1S1pKTU43RWl3SFh3Yk9nT0hhd01JQnhqaVlkd1hOTjVzNC1yUQ?oc=5) is exactly how volatility transfers wealth to the deepest pockets. Expect more distressed-AI shopping if August stays rough.
- **Retail + AI + leverage is a pre-written headline.** DIY hedge funds [44](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxQd1Vqc1FXWFJ0S3FtaWxVcDQwVUFZYlNQUDZGNjhNaGJTQWtNN2YtTk82OWtqckxsb1dCZGVwR1BpRTFXelNoc0p6SkNmTGVlV0FHTGJMTy0tQThMeEhFVU1fV1JNcFZwRFFfU0lUeFB6aF9LbWRuY294SEcyUjJGc0g3UTlSRUgwZ1IyLU5yUGU1X3Z1Vl9rQmpGdmpPMjZ4SjdqZE9mLUlwOWxOUWMyZzg5TmczV3c?oc=5) plus record AI-ETF volume share [45](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE9YbXd4OGxsZENYcTJWcFBOcEpoQk4td0RBdWduZUdJclZvcndCQlotTjBySldLX0dWNmktY1lJUW9FOFBaczR6ZUpTMDBxSmJIRjFRVGk5czFfM1JocnQxX1ZCcVJja3Bf?oc=5) equals retail concentration in the most crowded trade on earth.
- **Compliance is now a product feature.** EU disclosure rules [67](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE16WGZDaFdEd2x5aTFOendoUm5nT2RCTWZuMmt1eE5fNU5HNFBHNXU3a0puUllwZzJvbXFXY3JSdTBJNTdwU1dMa25abFpnZ0p2QnlyRno2eWJJaG8wYnN3NlhoQ3NtV2preU1YTW9BWG5aUG14M1FWajNR?oc=5) mean "is your AI labeled?" joins "is your data safe?" [32](https://news.google.?oc=5) on every wealth platform's checklist.
